prompt: Collect facts about the harness card in packages/agent-core (the per-call message that starts with '[Harness card'). Do not change any file. Report, each with path:line evidence: (1) the file that builds it; (2) after how many single-read turns in a row it advises batching (name the constant and its value); (3) after how many slices of one file it advises grep (constant and value); (4) for how many early steps it stays silent when it has nothing to say (constant and value); (5) how many working-set files it lists at most (constant and value). Write [NOT FOUND] for anything you cannot find.
